title: Lemon & garden greens orzo
description: A little sunshine in a bowl. Bright lemon, tender greens and a handful of basil.
steps: Cook the orzo in salted water until tender, adding the peas for the final 3 minutes. Reserve a mug of cooking water, then drain.
Warm the olive oil in a pan. Add the tomatoes and cook until softened, then fold in the spinach.
Add the orzo, peas, lemon zest and a squeeze of lemon juice. Loosen with a splash of reserved water.
Season to taste, scatter over the basil and serve warm.

title: The feel-good harvest bowl
description: Roasted sweet potato, crisp greens and creamy tahini. Lunch with a little more colour.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the sweet potato and chickpeas with a little oil and roast for 25 minutes.
Cook the quinoa following the packet instructions. Slice the avocado and cucumber.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and a little water until pourable.
Divide everything between two bowls. Finish with the pickled onion, cilantro and dressing.

title: Slow morning tomato toast
description: Jammy tomatoes, whipped ricotta and good sourdough. A reason to sit down for breakfast.
steps: Warm the oil in a pan and add the tomatoes. Cook for 8 minutes until they soften and blister.
Toast the sourdough. Stir a pinch of salt and pepper into the ricotta.
Spread the ricotta onto the toast and spoon over the tomatoes.
Finish with basil and a little olive oil. Serve straight away.

title: Golden salmon & herby lentils
description: Crisp-edged salmon, earthy lentils and lemon. A satisfying dinner without the fuss.
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season. Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the salmon skin-side down for 5 minutes, then turn and cook until opaque and cooked through.
Meanwhile steam the asparagus and warm the lentils with lemon zest, dill and a little oil.
Serve the salmon over the lentils with asparagus, lemon wedges and extra dill.
